senses.gloss: (cmp. שָׁתָה I) to come down slowly, flow gently.
units: <cite ref="Keritot 22a:35">Ker. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>מפני שהוא שׁוֹתֵת</he> because it (the last blood, <cite ref="V00702"><he>תַּמְצִית</he></cite>) flows gently, opp. <he>מקלח</he>.

<cite ref="Chullin 38a:6">Ḥull. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>בשׁוֹתֶתֶת</he> when the animal discharges excrements in a lax manner, opp. <he>מתרזת</he>. Ohol. III, 5 <he>השותת</he> blood that flows gently, opp. <he>המנטף</he>, that drips. Ib.; <cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 4:11">Tosef. ib. IV, 11</cite>, v. <cite ref="R00479"><he>צָלַב</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 44b:5">Bekh. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>בשותת</he> when he discharges urine laxly; a. e.—
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 19">Num. R. s. 19</cite>, beg. <he>מפני מה … ולשונך שותת</he> why dost thou go about with thy tongue slavering?; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:11">Koh. R. to X, 11</cite>.
